title: Health
description: GET /health. The add-on's own account of itself and of its target. Served even when the target is unreachable.

reachable.description: A real call to the target just succeeded.

version_tested.description: The target's major version is one this add-on mutates.

last_read_at.description: When the add-on last read the target.

key_expires_at.description: When the target credential expires; present only when key_expiry is set.

key_expiry.description: Which of three states the credential is in.

shares_readable.description: The share list could be read at all.

circuit_open.description: The add-on is refusing its own calls to the target.

drained.description: A non-active add-on has finished settling.

log_head.description: The mutation log's chain head, which the backend anchors.

snapshot_taken_at.description: When the add-on's mirror of the target was taken.
